test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 29 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper fixes the marked price of an item at 45% more than its purchase price. How much discount should be given to make a profit of 16%?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price % above purchase price = 45%

Desired profit % = 16%

**Formula Used:**

Marked Price (MP) = Cost Price (CP) × (1 + Marked price %/100)

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) × (1 + Profit %/100)

Discount % = ((Marked Price (MP) - Selling Price (SP)) / Marked Price (MP)) × 100

**Calculations:**

Let CP = 100

MP = 100 × (1 + 45/100)

⇒ MP = 100 × 1.45 = 145

SP = 100 × (1 + 16/100)

⇒ SP = 100 × 1.16 = 116

Discount = MP - SP

⇒ Discount = 145 - 116 = 29

Discount % = (Discount / MP) × 100

⇒ Discount % = (29 / 145) × 100

⇒ Discount % = 20%

**∴ The discount should be 20%.**
